ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed JOUR 400 should not register for JOUR 210. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.Journalism Master's students should register for lab section AB1 (CRN 62999).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or Broadcast Journalism or Agricultural Communications major(s).
